# Knight scene and clothing edit sequence

[← Back to all cases](../../README.md#all-cases)

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Official launch demo · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

Multi-step editing requires the initial image, not a standalone text-to-image prompt: sunset valley, floating castle/waterfalls/dragon, then ivory-and-gold armor with ruby details and crimson cloth.
